grades.quote: |3|DA|RW|Direct address translation mode enable bit, which is active high.
grades.reason: This passage gives the CRMD.DA and CRMD.PG field definitions. DA is the direct address translation mode enable bit and PG is the mapped address translation mode enable bit. It also says the legal (DA, PG) combinations are (0,1) or (1,0), and that other combinations give uncertain results. It also covers how hardware changes these bits on TLB refill and machine error exceptions. The mode-to-bit mapping is implied by the field names and not stated as an explicit table.
